goal: Get the LSP and the parts of the compiler and tooling that support it onto the centralised naming system and merged to the rust branch; VM/runtime and other unmigrated parts continue afterwards.

decisions.focus: Pause side work that does not unblock the merge; keep integration admissions, partial-row closure, and performance fixes for tests that time out in CI; then rebase on origin/rust, make rust-check, prep-pr and a PR. Park the rest as tracked follow-ups.
decisions.jim_dialect: Jim Tcl is a separate core dialect from C Tcl. The registry fix lives in tcl-registry (Rust), not tcl-spectcl: Jim builds its own core store there; the .tclspec own-surface stays for now.
